title: Referral packet review
description: One review per packet. This is the shape score.py reads. You may add your own fields.

packet_id.description: Folder name of the packet, for example R01.

recommendation.description: A recommendation for the coordinator, who makes the decision. Use needs_info when the packet cannot support a yes or a no.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences the coordinator could send to the hospital.

findings.description: The criteria that matter for this packet. Rule IDs come from criteria/admission-criteria.json. Leave out rules that do not apply. The 'ask' rules (IDs ending in -Q1, -Q2...) are questions, not pass or fail; put their answers in the summary or follow_up_questions.

rule.description: For example MOB-3, INF-1, GI-X3, FORM-X4.

status.description: met: requirement satisfied, or the exclusion does not apply. not_met: requirement fails, or the exclusion applies. unknown: the packet does not say, or says it is still pending.

note.description: Optional. Use it when a rule is unclear or only partly applies.

page.description: Page number in the packet PDF, starting at 1.

quote.description: The words on that page that support the finding.

missing_documents.description: Checklist items not in the packet. IDs DOC-1 to DOC-10 from the referral checklist.

follow_up_questions.description: What the coordinator should ask the hospital.

contradictions.description: Places where two documents in the packet disagree.
